name: Beijing Global Safety Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Global Safety Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in delivering comprehensive solutions across vital sectors such as energy management, urban infrastructure safety, advanced fire protection, cybersecurity, and customs security with integrated information management. The company operates both within China and across international markets. Among its core product offerings is GS-911CAD, a sophisticated computer-aided dispatch system designed for real-time information exchange, analytical insights, and dynamic incident deployment. Another key solution, GS-EYE, provides integrated transport security management, facilitating public information services, live situational awareness, and seamless data flow between transport authorities, drivers, and their vehicles. Additionally, the ECMS empowers command centers to effectively manage and respond to emergency incidents. The company also offers a dedicated mobile application to assist on-site personnel with emergency response operations. Its 3D sand table technology provides digital scenario simulations and custom models for various applications, including emergency preparedness, urban safety, and community security initiatives. Practical emergency kits and a portable, on-site platform system for disaster management further complement their product line. Beyond its product suite, Beijing Global Safety Technology Co., Ltd. provides a comprehensive range of services, encompassing expert consulting, solution design, financial facilitation, on-site implementation, post-implementation support, and specialized training programs. Established in 2005, the company is headquartered in Beijing, China.
